actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Redraw this complete sheet of two non-operational fictional anime character daggers, FRONT views only. Keep their current whole outlines' tip and pommel endpoint positions, common bottom baseline, and the successful 6:7 DARK:IVORY total-length relationship. Keep the two established designs and clean cel style. No action, character, internal construction or manufacturing details.
Correct ONLY the proportion problem: both handle assemblies in this sheet are still far too long and thick. Make both hilt assemblies about ONE THIRD shorter and the grips about HALF their current width. Place the guard/blade-root junction much lower on each complete object. The broad blade must occupy about68% of the DARK total length and73% of IVORY total length. Thus the two guards should sit at almost the SAME low height, roughly three quarters down the overall sheet. Keep the full tips and pommel ends fixed; extend the blades down to those lower guards rather than shrinking whole objects.
Both single-hand visible grips should be nearly equal in length, roughly one sixth of the longer ivory dagger's total length. Make pommels very compact: dark polygon pommel only about two fifths of its grip length; ivory teardrop pommel only one third of its grip length. Compact guard/collar above grip, no oversized root blocks. Grips are narrow—about one third of the dark blade width, and a little more than one third of the ivory blade width. The ivory blade's broadest section can be modestly wider than in the attachment, retaining its swept curved silhouette.
Preserve DARK angular broad charcoal fang blade/concave waist/gray edge and restrained red accent; compact asymmetric angular black guard with bent end, ONE red collar, slim angular black grip, short black polygon pommel with orange rectangular inset. Preserve IVORY swept ivory curved blade/gray edge, compact crescent ivory-and-black guard, ONE red collar, slim curved black grip with ivory inlay, short ivory teardrop pommel/orange oval. Exterior parts remain clearly distinct. Clean hand-drawn Japanese anime lines and cel planes, no dirty texture, cloudy white stains, random speckle or photo rendering. White background, tiny DARK / IVORY labels only; no edge views or dimension writing.

native_output.record_note: Actual output metadata retains the returned tool-native PNG path; the complete unchanged image payload is preserved in that native file.

reference_inputs.role: Bunny exterior identity and successful relative whole lengths only; long bulky hilts explicitly rejected

reference_basis: The sole actual input is v3 for exterior identity and relative overall lengths. Its bulky long hilts were explicitly rejected and corrected by the saved request. No extra input or accepted status is fabricated.
method: built-in image_gen.imagegen complete-image generation; byte-exact PNG copy and lossless WebP only
limitations: Front appearance master only; no EDGE view, accepted side thickness or grip side depth.
Original total lengths .36H0/.42H0 remain fixed; v2 details are defined from this source and do not claim all initial v1 targets were met.
Artwork-to-design-unit conversion is not a new body registration or manufacturing measurement.
